evaluation_procedure_001.answer: yes. Article 15 - Teacher Evaluation; outlines consultation, documentation, and grievance procedures, but notes instruments are non-negotiable and DCPS-controlled rather than detailing the full procedure.
evaluation_procedure_001.evidence: Article 15 - TEACHER EVALUATION... 15.2.1. The WTU shall have the opportunity to consult with the Chancellor on the Teacher evaluation process prior to its implementation. 15.2.2. Teachers will be provided a copy of the documentation of all formal observations prior to the end of the school year.
